summary:
The Indian market snapped a two-day losing streak as the Nifty closed above 23,200, supported by gains in metals and FMCG.
While IT stocks faced pressure, positive growth forecasts from Moody's and easing oil prices boosted investor sentiment.
Meanwhile, forex reserves saw a decline and bond markets faced their fifth weekly loss amid Fed and RBI policy shifts.
